question: Which deities or guardians are assigned to the south-western direction and to Sugrīva and Puṣpadantaka?
premises: The verse names the south-western direction.
It names a doorkeeper in that direction.
It also names Sugrīva and Puṣpadantaka.
inference: The verse assigns or locates these named figures in the stated directional and positional context.
uncertainties: The exact doctrinal role of each named figure is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: In the south-west is the doorkeeper, and in Sugrīva and Puṣpadantaka.
